checkpoints.description: [1/3] Planning golden coverage plus import-csv template

[1/3] Planning trend since/until to close window asymmetry

impact_assessment.why: Stats, batch and correlation slice by record time but trend reads the full group, so paired analyses disagree on n
impact_assessment.benefits: Consistent windowing across all analysis reads; window stored in result and event detail
impact_assessment.risks: contract: x stays recording position re-indexed within window; trend still records claim.trend event; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: single writer; state: no schema change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first window tests; golden windowed trend before report out; full suite plus aikit check; explicit staging

[1/3] Planning audit fixes for T-021..T-023: UTC-normalize bounds, batch fail-fast, fix flag hint

impact_assessment.why: Non-UTC --since/--until offsets break lexicographic at comparison; invalid batch bounds hide as per-claim errors instead of refusing loudly
impact_assessment.benefits: Correct cross-timezone windows; loud flag refusal; accurate help text
impact_assessment.risks: contract: bound strings stay +00:00 second-resolution; batch invalid flags now exit non-zero; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: single writer; state: no schema change
impact_assessment.mitigation: New regression tests for offset bounds and batch refusal; full suite plus aikit check; explicit staging

[1/6] M0 baseline and inventory: branch, six source SHAs, baseline suites, parity matrix, ADR

impact_assessment.why: Six sibling projects hold research mechanics that duplicate or fragment the lifecycle; the host needs one evidence-backed map before any code moves
impact_assessment.benefits: Reproducible pre-merge baseline, immutable source SHAs, and a capability matrix that bounds every later port
impact_assessment.risks: contract: source repos must remain untouched; dependency: read committed HEAD only, no in-flight work; concurrency: none, sources are read-only; state: no host schema change in M0
impact_assessment.mitigation: Create a dedicated merge branch, pin SHAs in docs, rerun each source suite, and map every listed capability to a target module before editing
